confirmation_rule: A candidate becomes an immutable occurrence only when both symbols expose the same M15 confirmation-close identity and exactly one corresponding level is touched. The ACL-03 anchor_time is the canonical alias of confirmation_close_time, and direction is the canonical alias of intrinsic relation_polarity.
deduplication_rule: A stable identity over all declared identity fields suppresses duplicate emission during replay, restart, and repeated hunter touches. anchor_time equals confirmation_close_time, direction equals relation_polarity, and subject_key equals symbol_pair_id; these aliases add compiler interoperability and do not add new domain meaning.
expiry_rule: A later protected-symbol touch after confirmation transitions the scoped reference to REFERENCE_EXHAUSTED without deleting the historical occurrence.
invalidation_rule: If both corresponding levels are touched before confirmation, the candidate transitions to BOTH_SIDES_TOUCHED and no divergence occurrence is created.
start_rule: The earliest tick-size-normalized touch of exactly one symbol-local reference level creates one candidate state for the registered family, reference, pair, and level side. The ACL-03 subject_key is the canonical alias of symbol_pair_id.
